context_and_flow.screen_type: A dashboard screen of a fitness tracking mobile application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To provide a user with a quick overview of their current fitness progress and quick actions for logging workouts.
ux_patterns: Uses standard iOS UI elements like top status bar.
Icons represent the type of metric (flame for streak, moon for rest).

visual_keywords: Minimalist mobile app interface, card-based layout.
